description: • I am a solo participant passionate about space and technology, working on an interactive project for Moon and Mars exploration.
summary: Stellar Kord is an innovative web application developed using the Kleap platform to tackle the "Abandoned but not forgotten" challenge in the NASA Space Apps Challenge. Our project transforms overlooked historical and space-related data into an engaging, accessible, and easy-to-digest storytelling experience suitable for all age groups. By bridging complex information with intuitive visual design, Stellar Kord aims to raise deep awareness, reconnect people with forgotten records, and foster a greater sense of curiosity, connection, and preservation across generations
details: Stellar Kord is an innovative web application built using the Kleap website builder platform for the Abandoned but not forgotten challenge in the NASA Space Apps Challenge. The project aims to clarify and simplify information so that it is easily understood by all age groups. On the creative side, the project features an engaging, accessible, and user-friendly visual layout that transforms complex data into a compelling, easy-to-digest storytelling experience for everyone. The expected benefit of this project is to raise deep awareness, reconnect people with overlooked and abandoned historical or space-related data, and foster a greater sense of connection and preservation across generations.
